body:
Hello!

I wanted to ask what your timeline for full integration of traffic simulation is (as opposed to just replay).

Thank you!

comments.body: Unfortunately we're all spread thin a bit atm since we're working on other (exciting!) improvements, and the trafficsim is not the highest priority right now. We definitely want to include it, if I had to guess, maybe a few months? But that's a guess, not a plan.

title: Timeline for traffic simulation?
